Breathing sped up - rapid heartbeat - whoozy and head rush - in some ways reminded me of that old lockeroom stuff, like glue stiffing but lasts longer and likely healthier. Granted it was one time but I did not find it very pleasant - perhaps long term island users grow used to it.
